description: Built-in AI agent for Lynx CMS on the Laravel AI SDK.
Page cache for Lynx CMS: guest pages stored as HTML, served by the web server or before Laravel's session starts, and cleared when content changes.
Interfaces and DTOs for Lynx CMS modules.
Lynx CMS core: languages, fields, templates, pages, selectors and actions.
Forms for Lynx CMS: forms defined in code, Livewire rendering, submissions in the admin and notifications.
MCP server for Lynx CMS, generated from the action registry.
Images and files for Lynx CMS: per-page media fields, variations and admin uploads.
Menu builder for Lynx CMS: multilingual menus stored as pages, rendered with any Blade view.
Password-protected pages for Lynx CMS (pagePassword): a password set on a page locks it and the pages below it for visitors.
SEO for Lynx CMS: meta and social tags, canonical links, robots rules and robots.txt, per template SEO fields.
XML sitemaps for Lynx CMS: every published page in every language, split into parts past a limit set in config or the admin.
Exports a Lynx CMS site as static files: every published page in every language, the public files, a 404 page and redirects, to host without PHP.
